architecture_summary.active_roster: Vanilla static array of 56 characters preserved intact. Murray uses global.CustomNight_Page = 1.

bugs_to_fix.bug: addons/Murray/ missing 48x48 icon.png. Requires icon.png (48x48) + portrait.png (500x500) + extras_info.txt without extra large images to prevent sprite_merge crash.
gml_Object_oGameOver_Draw_0 reads global.TimeLasted. Murray transitions directly with room_goto(GameOver) without formatting global.TimeLasted from global.TimerMinutes, TimerSeconds, TimerDecimal.
sMurray_Jumpscare texture coords were hacked in CSX atlas packer and drawn in 2 layers in Draw_64 with offsets. Solution: pre-composite into full 640x640 single frames and draw_sprite_ext in 1 call.
Only allow window knock: murray_knock.ogg (sfxKnock). Strip all extra voice/grunt/breathing lines.
Murray NEVER forces window blinds open (my_blind.Open = true forbidden). Pauses attack if blind is closed.
Quick buttons [-1][+1][0][20] collide with description text in Page 1. Modded button in vanilla grid looks unpolished.

frickbears_mod.addon_metadata:
{ "FULL_NAME": "Murray Moose", "DEBUT": "2025", "DESCRIPTION": "Created as one of the prototype models for a new form of Advanced IA, Murray was meant to be the star of the new wave of animatronic performers made by Voltur-enterprise. Sadly Murray never got to see the light of day after being deemed too defective for... Certain reasons.

He, of course, won't accept that kind of fate! His career has yet to start, and he'll make the most out of it!

Just... Don't tell him Disco music isn't really popular anymore.", "DEV_NOTES": "Murray was originally created to be the face of a FNaF coop map for Minecraft! I asked my best friend to give me two random topics and he said "Disco and Moose" That's all i needed to create our Freddy Fazbear!

Although that original map was never finished it serve as a base for all these charscters growth.

Murray holds a special place in my heart, as I'm writing this my friend Peter Is doing His absolute best to code him as our first new character! If you're reading this, congrat us! That means we made it to the end!", "VACredit": "Peter Z" }
